asr.full_text: Welcome to this private presentation of how you can be a part of an inspiring business opportunity that will have a great positive impact in your personal finances. It is a business that has an impressive future with a plan and strategy that covers every little detail and you should really appreciate the fact that you get to hear about OneCoin in this phase. We are now an impressive amount of members and have a global growth of more than a thousand people per day. Our ambition during the upcoming 10 minutes is to give you a good thought of what kind of impact OneCoin will have on you. We really feel that this is the best opportunity out there. The idea and vision with OneCoin was born out of bitcoin's success which paved way to a new, large and a growing financial market. Have you ever heard about Bitcoin? Some say yes, and some say no. The first time many us heard about Bitcoin, was in the end of 2013 or the beginning of 2014, and by that time time many people had already became millionaires but at that point the opportunity for us that did not invest was all gone those who became millionaires a few years earlier heard about a new currency that took form most people who were told about it however did not invest in it mainly because it was something they could not understand today those people deeply regret this decision hearing and reading various success stories such as the norwegian who bought bitcoin for 26 us dollars forget all about it only to later learn that his small investment had become over 850 000 dollars. Had these people been asked today knowing what, was they would naturally have chosen to invest. BitCoin was created in 2008 and the first two years there was hardly anyone who understood it or heard about it The phenomenon started with a small mailing list to a few computer-savvy people and only during the period from 2010 to the end of 2013, the value went from 0.1 USD to 1.203 USD. That's 12000 times the money. You now have seen what happened with those who invested in Bitcoin. How would you like to be involved in the next cryptocurrency revolution? With the big difference that this time it's worldwide, this time it's organized, and this time it's an opportunity available to everyone. An opportunity that fits everyone who want to expand their portfolio and have multiple income streams. Onecoin is a company registered in Gibraltar and have offices in both Bulgaria & Hong Kong. The person behind Onecoin is Dr. Rucha Ignatova that in a very sophisticated manner have impressed many of us. She is only 35 years old and already with a stunning biography. Born in Sofia, Bulgaria and raised in Germany, two degrees in economics and law that she studied in only four years total, at Oxford and Konstanz. Associate Partner at McKinsey and Company where she worked with big multinational banks as Spellbank, Unicredit, Allian alliance within corporate banking private equity asset management risk management operating and liquidity risk the former CEO and CFO at one of the biggest asset management funds in Bulgaria with over 250 million assets under management published two books which been translated into German and Chinese. Consulting work for several cryptocurrency companies. Won the prize as the best female entrepreneur in both 2012 and 2014 the latter within all categories for the innovation within OneCoin. Why do one could have much higher potential than Bitcoin In the same time, blockchain is an incredibly fast-growing investment in Bitcoin, including Bitcoin. Why do wangoin have much higher potential than Bitcoin More advanced and highly secure algorithm A dedicated management, which in combination with a fast-growing network creates a strong and well-known brand that enables us, through WangCard, to make an effortless currency exchange anywhere in the world at any time. WonCoin is centralized and therefore does not attract drug and weapons money as bitcoin have done with its anonymity. Woncoin is stil in a very early stage and is therefore very interesting for investors, bitcoin is already very mature and therefore the possibility of a large capital game is all over. With OneCoin, you and I don't have to invest in expensive computer equipment. We join the mining process through a click of a button over the internet. Bitcoin is NOT accepted in China, so China is now paving the way for a huge market for OneCoin, a cryptocurrency that is accepted in most countries in the world. This because of the decentralization and traceability of OneCoin as a currency. When You Invest In Your Financial Future Through OneCoin, What's in it for You? annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it actively promotes OneCoin as a business and investment opportunity, directing viewers toward paid packages that provide tokens and access to OneCoin mining. It presents highly specific and extraordinary profit projections, including hundreds of thousands of euros from the packages, while using Bitcoin success stories, urgency, and lifestyle appeals to encourage participation. The central solicitation links payment for packages to mining income and token appreciation rather than neutrally analyzing cryptocurrency.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S04 fits because the video presents paid OneCoin packages containing tokens and links them to participation in OneCoin mining and projected mining profits. S05 is separately evidenced because the same token packages are promoted with predicted appreciation and capital gains.
